entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. It's a complete piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? I prefer things that actually work! The interface is so incredibly **confusing**. It's just plain **hard to use**. I've spent hours with the **user manual** and it's useless. I certainly **expected more** from you guys.
I understand your frustration. It sounds like the controls aren't as intuitive as you'd hoped. Sometimes a quick walkthrough can clear things up—

I don't want a walkthrough! I want a refund! Are you deaf? This is unbelievable. Get me your manager right now. I swear I will post reviews on every single website about this garbage product and your terrible service.
Okay, okay, that won't be necessary. I can certainly look into the return options for you. I just need to confirm when you received the item.
I got it a couple of weeks ago, I don't know the exact date! Just look it up!
Of course. One moment... I see here it was delivered 17 days ago. Let me just pull up our policy... Okay, it looks like you're all set.
What does 'all set' mean? Are you giving me a refund or not?
Yes, I am. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that window. I can process a full refund for you right now. I'll email a prepaid shipping label to you.
Oh. Well... fine. That's all I wanted in the first place. Send the label.
The email has just been sent to the address we have on file. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I apologize again for the inconvenience.
